title: Oy har yili Yerdan taxminan 3,8 santimetr uzoqlashadi
hook: Oy har yili Yerdan taxminan 3,8 santimetr uzoqlashadi.

scenes.text: Oy har yili Yerdan taxminan 3,8 santimetr uzoqlashib boradi.
Buni Apollon astronavtlari 1969 yildan boshlab Oyda qoldirgan maxsus oynalar orqali o'lchashadi.
Olimlar Yerdan lazer yuboradi va nur qaytib kelguncha o'tgan vaqtni hisoblaydi.
Sababi suv ko'tarilishi: u Yer aylanishini sekinlashtiradi va Oyni asta uzoqlashtiradi.
Bu tezlik taxminan tirnoq o'sish tezligiga teng.

description:
Oy har yili Yerdan taxminan 3,8 santimetr uzoqlashadi. Buni 1969 yildan beri Apollon astronavtlari Oyda qoldirgan oynalarga lazer yuborib o'lchashadi.

Siz buni bilarmidingiz? Izohda "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-12 (web search): all claims TRUE, no text change. NASA eclipse site: laser ranging shows the Moon receding about 3.8 cm per year; first reflector placed by Apollo 11 in 1969 (Apollo 14 and 15 and two Soviet Lunokhod reflectors followed). Cause is tidal friction transferring Earth's rotational energy to the Moon's orbit. Fingernail comparison is a rough image repeated by Live Science citing NASA (nails grow about 3-4 cm a year), hence 'taxminan'. Sources: https://eclipse.gsfc.nasa.gov/help/ApolloLaser.html ; https://www.livescience.com/space/the-moon/will-earth-ever-lose-its-moon ; https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/longest-laser-ranging-experiment
